title: hieracium salevense subsp. neurophyllum
intro: Hieracium salevense subsp. neurophyllum, commonly known as Mountain Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium salevense subsp. neurophyllum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine for its wound-healing and anti-inflammatory properties.
